implication: Even removing all non-payload requested heap saves at most about 2.9 MB in this frozen ownership scenario; prioritize time here and larger avoidable arrays in other real loads.
scope: During complete computation, original immutable fixture and owned readonly request inputs coexist with three current and three previous vector results. Excludes ndarray/metadata/allocator overhead, scratch, Python arenas and mmap. This is a storage bound for this benchmark scope, not a universal production memory bound.
